excerpt: Hi, a while ago I made Zpup, small library that inspired by Zdog. I kept working on it, and it grew in to nice tool for making 3D scenes. The link is small game drawn with it. Image models cant draw the same thing twice. but Zpup solves this with simple way. the model writes small 3D scene as JSON, Zpup draws it from any angle. the objects are written once, so it looks same in every direction. I wrote the game rules by hand. the resources are simple. they will not look better than image models. because it is not 3D engine. Repo (MIT):
